messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: spatial data in local coordinates (=not in WGS84 / lat - lon)
parts: The basemap for leaflet is EPSG:4326, which interprets lat/long coordinates on the WGS84 reference ellipsoid. So if your data are in EPSG:2100, this may explain why it isn't loading correctly. However, Wallace should be able to load the data correctly based on the lat and long. Make sure your values are in decimal degrees.
